opportunities.name: Mana-to-contact budget
opportunities.objective: Test whether a second mana source keeps Flux resets productive during longer contact.
opportunities.mechanic: Passive AP increases max mana and spells explicitly use bonus-mana-linked resource formulas. Actualizer supplies a limited empowered window with doubled mana costs and faster basic cooldown progress; transformed Seraph supplies finite mana/shielding. E/W reset Q and two runes grant speed; Frozen Heart is a matchup mana/armor slot.
opportunities.requiredState: Seraph earned; record AP, bonus/max mana and Actualizer resource expenditure.
opportunities.failure: Empty mana or movement that loses Q hits destroys the proposed extra cast value.
opportunities.test: Count successful E-Q/W-Q cycles and remaining mana with and without Actualizer active.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: AP-mana feedback cannot be iterated to an invented infinite stat pool.

opportunities.name: Flux-bound attack interval
opportunities.objective: Explore one Spellblade attack between Flux setup and reset-Q output.
opportunities.mechanic: Q is refreshed by E/W, while E supplies Flux and E-W gives a root. Lich Bane rewards an actual attack during that controlled interval; Nashor asks whether further attacks repay their animation time. Rod provides finite mana/AP/health growth and Cosmic rewards magic damage with movement.
opportunities.requiredState: E-W root connected and an attack does not delay a needed Q; Rod age recorded.
opportunities.failure: Attack weaving lowers spell frequency or consumes the root window before the next Q lands.
opportunities.test: Compare spell-only and one-attack root sequences at matched mana/AP, recording cast delays.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Q reset does not reset Spellblade cooldown or turn Q into an attack.

ruledOut.reason: R active teleports allies without damaging enemies; its Flux Q bonus is passive and does not establish Hatefog from the portal.

unknowns: AbilityResource(default, statFormula=2) is preserved; Seraph Awe and Actualizer amplification lack numeric source coefficients. Record observed stats instead.

builds.name: Mana-to-contact budget
builds.summary: Test whether a second mana source keeps Flux resets productive during longer contact.
builds.goal: Test whether a second mana source keeps Flux resets productive during longer contact.
builds.hypothesis: Passive AP increases max mana and spells explicitly use bonus-mana-linked resource formulas. Actualizer supplies a limited empowered window with doubled mana costs and faster basic cooldown progress; transformed Seraph supplies finite mana/shielding. E/W reset Q and two runes grant speed; Frozen Heart is a matchup mana/armor slot.
testPlan: Required state: Seraph earned; record AP, bonus/max mana and Actualizer resource expenditure.
Count successful E-Q/W-Q cycles and remaining mana with and without Actualizer active.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Empty mana or movement that loses Q hits destroys the proposed extra cast value.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: AP-mana feedback cannot be iterated to an invented infinite stat pool.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Actualizer, Seraph's Embrace, Frozen Heart, Cosmic Drive, Void Staff, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula: Ryze deals [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.6) × AP + 0.03 × AbilityResource(default, statFormula=2)] magic damage and Slows by [50]% for [1.5] seconds. If the target has Flux, it is consumed and this Ability Roots instead of Slowing.

Passive: {{Spell_RyzeW_Name}} and {{Spell_RyzeE_Name}} refresh this Ability's Cooldown and charge a rune for [4] seconds (max [2] runes).

Active: Ryze unleashes a blast, dealing [75 / 95 / 115 / 135 / 155 + (0.55) × AP + 0.02 × AbilityResource(default, statFormula=2)] magic damage to the first enemy hit. If the target has Flux on it, it is consumed, causing this Ability to deal @Spell.RyzeR:OverloadDamageBonus@% increased damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux.

Ryze also discharges all runes, granting Ryze [28 / 32 / 36 / 40 / 44]% Move Speed for [2] seconds if [2] runes were charged.

Ryze fires an orb, dealing [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.5) × AP + 0.02 × AbilityResource(default, statFormula=2)] magic damage and applies Flux for [4] seconds to the target and nearby enemies. Enemies already afflicted with Flux will cause it to spread further.
Ryze gains [((10) × AP) × (0.01)]% max Mana. His Abilities do additional damage based on his bonus Mana.
